name: Sea Bass
siboNotes: Sea bass is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. Choose simple preparation methods to avoid triggering ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil, oregano, or thyme
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Grill, bake, or pan-sear with olive oil for best digestibility
Avoid breading with wheat flour - use gluten-free alternatives if needed
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in omega-3 fatty acids for heart and brain health
Good source of selenium and vitamin B12
